purpose: Validation-only test of a bounded AutoCon-representation-conditioned blend between the existing MambaTSv3 forecast and its shared persistence/linear projection.
research_question: On low-dimensional domains where frozen MambaTSv3 underperformed linear or patch baselines, can an AutoCon-representation-conditioned bounded Mamba/linear blend improve exact v3 while remaining within a 10% prediction-plus-representation latency budget?
evidence_boundary: Exploratory validation-only factorial. Every job sets skip_test=true. It cannot select a held-out candidate, alter released test results, or support a universal Mamba/AutoCon claim.
claim_boundary: A pass requires paired improvement over exact v3 on at least two of three registered datasets and no more than 2% deficit against the strongest registered external baseline on those same datasets. The AutoCon lambda is fixed and the blend is only a representation-connected architectural route; this screen does not establish the independent causal contribution of the relation loss.

required_before_launch: verify the three dataset fingerprints and exact 45-job matrix
preserve the same optimizer, split, normalization and budget for candidate, exact control and external baselines
freeze source snapshot and immutable launch sidecar before GPU execution

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The blend bias, representation fusion, AutoCon lambda and all budget settings are fixed before execution; no post-hoc lambda, width or bias sweep is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Candidate, exact MambaTSv3 control and external baselines share data loader, chronological split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and MeanStd normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_difference: Only the candidate enables mamba_ts_repr_linear_expert=true with mode=blend. The blend reuses v3's existing persistence head, adds no Mamba scan, and gates with the same AutoCon representation used for fusion.

phases.name: exact_v3_control_h96
phases.purpose: Same MambaTSv3 AutoCon representation-fusion architecture without the linear blend.

phases.name: strong_external_baselines_h96
phases.purpose: Registered low-dimensional external baselines without candidate-only AutoCon or blend settings.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: blend candidate minus exact MambaTSv3AutoCon representation-fusion control
comparison_contract.pass_rule: candidate must improve exact control in at least 2/3 seeds on at least two datasets and be within 2% of the strongest external baseline on those datasets

stopping_rules: If fewer than two datasets satisfy both paired and external gates, stop this blend route with no held-out release or bias retuning.
If the candidate median prediction-plus-representation latency is more than 10% above exact v3 on ETTh1 same-shape resource replication, stop before any further expansion.
Report all three registered datasets, including failures, in the machine readout.
